tasks.name_en: Prepare a de-energized power drill for a controlled bit change
tasks.name_ja: 電源を切った電動ドリルを安全なビット交換準備状態にする
instruction_variants: Place the de-energized power drill in the service cradle and leave it ready for a controlled bit change.
Prepare the battery-removed drill for servicing without rotating the chuck or pressing the trigger.
電池を外した電動ドリルをサービス台に置き、チャックを回さずにビット交換の準備状態にしてください。

tasks.notes: Proposed design only; task-specific claims are carried in this bundle.
tasks.name_en: Measure the wood block and fit it in an adjustable spacer gap
tasks.name_ja: 木ブロックの厚さを測り、可変スペーサーの隙間に合わせる
instruction_variants: Measure the wood block thickness with the caliper, adjust the fixture gap to that measured thickness, and record the fit.
Use the caliper for both the block thickness and adjustable gap, then use a feeler gauge to measure the residual gap after seating the block.
木ブロックの厚さと可変治具の隙間をノギスで測り、ブロックを合わせた後の残り隙間をすきまゲージで測定して記録してください。

tasks.name_en: Align closed scissors in a blade-clearance fixture
tasks.name_ja: 閉じたはさみを刃のクリアランス治具に合わせる
instruction_variants: Seat the closed, guarded scissors on the blade-clearance fixture and record the 10 mm check.
Align the scissors to the marked axis without opening or cutting, then verify the clearance.
閉じて保護したはさみを刃のクリアランス治具の軸に合わせ、開かずに10 mmの確認結果を記録してください。

tasks.notes: Proposed design only; task-specific claims are carried in this bundle.
tasks.name_en: Check a closed padlock shackle in an open-ended gauge without unlocking it
tasks.name_ja: 閉じた南京錠のシャックルを開放端ゲージで解錠せずに確認する
instruction_variants: Place the closed padlock shackle into the compatible open-ended gauge and record the clearance without unlocking it.
Use a gauge that accepts the closed shackle loop from its open end; do not use a captive hasp or insert a key.
閉じた南京錠のシャックルを閉ループ対応の開放端ゲージに通し、解錠せずに隙間を記録してください。

tasks.notes: Proposed design only; task-specific claims are carried in this bundle.
tasks.name_en: Sort the attached-ring key set on a ring-compatible profile board
tasks.name_ja: リングを付けた鍵セットをリング対応の形状ボードで分別する
instruction_variants: Sort the counted keys by profile and length on the board while keeping their attached ring in the board's ring channel.
Use only a profile board compatible with the attached ring; record every slot assignment without separating the keys.
鍵をリングから外さず、付属リング対応ボードの溝に通したまま形状スロットへ分別して記録してください。

tasks.name_en: Orient a capped large marker in a label-scan fixture with its tip isolated
tasks.name_ja: キャップ付き太字マーカーを先端から隔離してラベル走査治具に向ける
instruction_variants: Seat the capped large marker in the scan fixture with the label facing the camera and the tip isolated.
Orient the large marker within 10 degrees of the camera axis without exposing or contacting its ink tip.
キャップを付けた太字マーカーをラベルがカメラを向くよう治具に置き、先端を露出・接触させないでください。

tasks.name_en: Check a capped small marker in a color and cap inspection cradle
tasks.name_ja: キャップ付き細字マーカーを色とキャップの検査台で確認する
instruction_variants: Seat the capped small marker in the inspection cradle, compare its color band with the chart, and keep its tip shielded.
Verify cap retention and the marked barrel color without exposing or contacting the writing tip.
キャップを付けた細字マーカーを検査台に置き、色とキャップを確認しながら先端を保護してください。

tasks.notes: Proposed design only; task-specific claims are carried in this bundle.
tasks.name_en: Align the adjustable wrench on a length reference and record handle clearance
tasks.name_ja: モンキーレンチを長さ基準に合わせ、ハンドルのクリアランスを記録する
instruction_variants: Align the unloaded adjustable wrench to the length reference and record the handle clearance without clamping a workpiece.
Keep the jaws in their neutral setting, place the wrench on the fixture, and document the visible length reading.
負荷をかけずにモンキーレンチを長さ基準へ合わせ、ハンドルの余裕と読み取り値を記録してください。

tasks.notes: Proposed design only; task-specific claims are carried in this bundle.
tasks.name_en: Present a Phillips screwdriver tip to a non-contact profile card
tasks.name_ja: プラスドライバーの先端を非接触プロファイルカードに向ける
instruction_variants: Place the Phillips screwdriver in the profile cradle and present its tip to the card without making contact or turning a fastener.
Keep the tip clear of the profile card, align the cross profile to the viewing window, and record the inspection.
プラスドライバーをプロファイル台に置き、先端をカードに接触させず十字形状を確認して記録してください。

tasks.notes: Proposed design only; task-specific claims are carried in this bundle.
tasks.name_en: Orient a flat screwdriver in a non-contact blade-width comparator
tasks.name_ja: マイナスドライバーを非接触の刃幅比較治具に向ける
instruction_variants: Orient the flat screwdriver at the blade-width comparator without applying contact load and record the visible width.
Keep the blade clear of the comparator, align its edge to the reference, and leave the tip guard ready for reset.
マイナスドライバーの刃を比較基準へ合わせ、治具に押し付けず幅を読み取って記録してください。

tasks.notes: Proposed design only; task-specific claims are carried in this bundle.
tasks.name_en: Count nails and stage them head-up in a protected count strip
tasks.name_ja: くぎを数え、保護された計数ストリップに頭を上にして並べる
instruction_variants: Count the nail set, place each nail head-up in a protected count pocket, and record the total without striking anything.
Keep every point isolated in the strip and compare the final count with the pretrial count card.
くぎを数え、頭を上にして保護されたポケットへ一本ずつ置き、打撃を加えず合計を記録してください。

tasks.notes: Proposed design only; task-specific claims are carried in this bundle.
tasks.name_en: Place a plastic bolt head-up in a non-mating thread inspection cradle
tasks.name_ja: プラスチックボルトを頭を上にして非嵌合ねじ検査台へ置く
instruction_variants: Seat the plastic bolt head-up in the inspection cradle and record the exposed thread condition without mating a nut.
Keep the thread view clear and inspect the bolt without torque, insertion, or forced contact.
プラスチックボルトを頭を上にして検査台へ置き、ナットをかみ合わせずねじ山の状態を記録してください。

tasks.notes: Proposed design only; task-specific claims are carried in this bundle.
tasks.name_en: Place a plastic nut on an open thread gauge without forcing engagement
tasks.name_ja: プラスチックナットを開放ねじゲージに無理なく載せる

Keep the matching bolt away from the station; do not turn, cross-thread, or force the nut.
プラスチックナットを開放ねじゲージに載せ、無理な回転やボルトとの嵌合をせず形状を記録してください。

tasks.notes: Proposed design only; task-specific claims are carried in this bundle.
tasks.name_en: Balance a hammer on a marked center-of-gravity cradle
tasks.name_ja: ハンマーを重心マーク付きクレードルでバランスさせる

Use the handle clearance zone to verify a stable, load-free orientation.
ハンマーを重心基準付きクレードルに載せ、打撃を加えず安定したバランス位置を記録してください。

tasks.notes: Proposed design only; task-specific claims are carried in this bundle.
tasks.name_en: Stage an unloaded small clamp open on a pinch-zone fixture
tasks.name_ja: 負荷をかけない小型クランプを開いた状態で挟み込み防止治具に置く

負荷のない小型クランプを開き、ハンドルを挟み込み境界の外に置いて確認してください。

負荷のない中型クランプを開口ストッパーまで開き、ワークに触れず隙間を記録してください。

tasks.notes: Proposed design only; task-specific claims are carried in this bundle.
tasks.name_en: Inspect large clamp jaw-pad symmetry in a non-contact comparison fixture
tasks.name_ja: 非接触比較治具で大型クランプのジョーパッド対称性を確認する

tasks.name_ja: 特大クランプを搬送クリアランス用クレードルに合わせる
